name: Karam Industrial Safety Hand Protection Gloves Range
shortDescription: Comprehensive professional industrial glove collection covering PU precision assembly, heavy cut-resistant HPPE, cow split leather welding, and chemical handling.
overview: Karam's comprehensive Hand Protection catalog represents the gold standard of occupational hand safety in India, spanning tailored solutions for every industrial hazard. From ultra-dexterous 13-gauge polyurethane (PU) coated palm gloves for micro-electronics and component assembly, to Cut Level 5 Kevlar/HPPE woven gloves for metal stamping, heavy cow-split leather gauntlets for high-amperage arc welding, and chemical-resistant neoprene/nitrile gauntlets for plating vats. Every glove in this series is rigorously certified to EN 388, EN 407, or EN 374 standards.
keyFeatures: Comprehensive safety spectrum: Cut protection, thermal barrier, chemical defense, and anti-static
Seamless knit ergonomic liners (Nylon, Polyester, Kevlar, HPPE) ensure zero seam chafing
Precision micro-foam nitrile, PU, and latex dip coatings suited to wet, dry, or oily tasks
Heavy-duty split cowhide leather welding gloves with Kevlar thread heat resistance
High tactile sensitivity allows handling tiny screws and fasteners with precision
Breathable knit backs promote airflow to keep operators cool in humid workshops
All batches tested and certified to European CE and Indian BIS safety norms
